description: Management of all financial and personnel records.

Menu development as well as food preparation.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate's profile stands out with extensive experience as an Executive Chef, Sous Chef, and Chef across various culinary operations. Their expertise in managing high-volume food services and successful menu development showcases strong leadership and operational skills. With a background that spans financial management of personnel records and direct involvement in recruitment and training, the candidate demonstrates comprehensive responsibility from kitchen to marketing. This robust experience combined with a degree from Los Angeles Culinary Institute positions them strongly within culinary leadership roles.
